answer: A sealed whisper commit blocks fakes. Each agent locks 70 credits and files a whisper hash with the juniper board. At reveal it shows the preimage; the river book takes only its key's hash. A borrowed whisper lacks its preimage; a second reveal forfeits the bond. Each whisper costs 42, kth 42+5(k-1): a thousand fakes pay 2,539,500 and lock 70,000 against a 40,000 pool. Rented whispers fail: one preimage fits one key. An honest agent pays 42 once.
